posts.body: So i just been learning the RPG Maker MV for a couple of days and yesterday I bought the Trinity DLC pack but the tilesets from that DLC are for RPG Maker MZ format, is there a way to convert it to MV Format

posts.body:

You'll have to explain more precisely what problems you're having - there's no difference in the tileset format between the two engines.

posts.author: EpicFILE
posts.body:
MV and MZ have the same format, so it'll work.
FSM for example sold MV and MZ tilesets,
but they can actually be used in both engine.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Steam requires DLC to be assigned to specific main programs. Because of that a lot of identical resources are in steam under two (or more) versions even if the files are identical.
Most of MV/MZ assets have identical formats, The only exceptions are the animation formats:
MZ needs a later version to support MV-type animations, the Effekseer files of MZ cannot be used in the MV editor at all.
